{{Quote|Welcome to Lamus. I am Jord of the A'Mar. We are pleased to have you here, to share our world with us.|Jord|<ref name="The Wellspring">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031218wellspring|text=The Wellspring|int=The Wellspring (roleplaying adventure)}}</ref>}}
'''Jord''' was the leader of the [[A'Mar]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] settlers of [[Lamus]]. She asked a group of offworlders to supervise [[Olianna]] when she took part in [[the Vigil]].
